correctness.rationale: The real nine-column basis 1,x,y,z,xy,yz,zx,x²-y²,y²-z² is H_<=2 on S² up to invertible scales. Modular reduction Q(sqrt5) to F101 via sqrt5->45 is valid; independent C++ enumeration of all C(20,8)=125970 eight-row sets yielded 123030 full rank, 2940 deficient, 40991 distinct rank-eight hyperplane closures of sizes 8:35820,9:4420,10:546,11:180,12:25. Hence no 13-point set lies in a rank-eight hyperplane. Independently generated exact Q(sqrt5) cofactor null vectors for all 25 twelve-point closures and checked their full 20-vertex zero sets equal exactly those 12 vertices; modular rank 8 gives one-dimensional kernels. Explicit 9-row modular rank certificate and the 12-point quadratic witness bound the threshold sharply. The modular obstruction is only used in the valid one-way direction; exact witnesses establish existence.
